package.description: A command-line tool to run engine vs engine matches in chess.

en-US.description: A command-line tool to run engine vs engine matches in chess.
en-US.name: Fast Chess
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- Tighten bestmove extraction by @robertnurnberg in #1002
- refactor: Show Last Extracted Line by @Disservin in #1003
- Extract bestmove only once by @robertnurnberg in #1004
- Simplify bestmove treatment by @robertnurnberg in #1005
- Only send warning about missing bestmove if engine did not timeout by @robertnurnberg in #1006
- add warning for mismatching mate scores by @robertnurnberg in #1001
- refactor: remove duplicated move storage by @Disservin in #1010
- refactor: move mate score check into function by @Disservin in #1011
- refactor: cleanup game loop by @Disservin in #1012
- swap params by @robertnurnberg in #1013
- fix spelling by @robertnurnberg in #1015
- refactor: score type usage by @Disservin in #1017
- Alternative fix to not compare scores from different games by @robertnurnberg in #1016
- Use isMate() by @robertnurnberg in #1018
- Use c'tor by @robertnurnberg in #1019
- refactor: optimize line read by @Disservin in #1020
- refactor: include overrun time info in timeout by @Disservin in #1024
- refactor: cleanup gameover logic by @Disservin in #1025
- chore: update chess library by @Disservin in #1027
- Gate -march=native to some architectures by @anematode in #1030
- Exit nonzero on any warning using flag -strict by @spinojara in #1028
- feat: better engine name defaults by @gahtan-syarif in #1031
- fix: default engine name when number of engines > 2 by @gahtan-syarif in #1032
- feat: default filename for pgnout and epdout by @gahtan-syarif in #1033
- refactor: stop on ctrl-break by @Disservin in #1036
- fix: deadlock engine nodes crash by @Disservin in #1040
- refactor: always use fs logic by @Disservin in #1037
- test: add game result tests by @Disservin in #1041
- refactor: make pv checks testable by @Disservin in #1042
- feat: add suggestions for unrecognized command-line options by @gahtan-syarif in #1044
- refactor: send ucinewgame after options by @Disservin in #1045
- tests: add snapshot tests by @Disservin in #1046
- chore: update man by @gahtan-syarif in #1048
- chore: update snapshot script by @Disservin in #1049
- test: update snapshots by @Disservin in #1050
- feat: add EngineWhiteName & EngineWhiteAuthor by @Disservin in #1051
- fix: don't add empty id/authors by @Disservin in #1052
- tests: add more e2e tests by @Disservin in #1047
- refactor: button option fix by @Disservin in #1053
- fix: missing increment by @Disservin in #1054

New Contributors
- @anematode made their first contribution in #1030
